versioning_note: Separate post-release-metadata design revision, prior to any NEON taxon/plot outcome opening. Original seven-taxon v1 eligibility and Level-A reference unmodified.
spatial_reference: NEON 400 m2 plot centers, nest within NEON site; CHELSA bio1-bio19 ~1km climatologies; identical predictor pixels may occur for multiple plots
planned_unit: site-aggregated proportion of completed plot-bouts with focal species detected

planned_computation.plot_aggregation: Within site, keep one predeclared most recent qualifying full 400m2 plot-bout per plotID; latest completion determined by data-availability/QC only, never focal-taxon presence
planned_computation.complete_bout: Must satisfy 6 x 1 m2, 6 x 10 m2, 4 x 100 m2, matched site/plot/event/bout, and sampling/taxonomy quality gates as in scripts/neon_complete_bout_gate_v1.py
planned_computation.species_label: detected if taxon precisely resolved in complete 400m2 survey; protocol-conditional non-detection otherwise only if completed and taxonomically identifiable
planned_computation.site_score: For each source-specific frozen SDM, median relative suitability across sites' admitted plot centroids, not the sample of 2000 original model background points
planned_computation.site_response: detection plot fraction = number of admitted plots detecting focal species / number of admitted complete plots
planned_computation.primary_statistic: site-level Kendall tau-b of frozen SDM site score against site detection fraction, computed separately for PRESERVED_SPECIMEN and HUMAN_OBSERVATION
planned_computation.secondary_statistic: per-taxon difference in tau-b between two source-specific SDMs; when both predictions are equally inaccurate, same-target cross-source coherence is not ecological correctness
planned_computation.additional_diagnostics: site-level predictor vector uniqueness, between-site score variance, climate-extrapolation, site-level uncertainty, source-specific outcome independence, and complete site-year effort
planned_computation.no_species_absence_claim: non-detection is protocol-conditional on completed plot only
planned_computation.avoid_pseudoreplication: site is independent geographic unit; 400m2 plots and bout-years nested within site, and 24 procedure×M cells repeated within taxa
planned_computation.primary_reporting_unit: taxon (up to seven), with site-level replication reported per taxon

extra_score_identifiability_requirements: At least three distinct site-level CHELSA climate predictor vectors for each taxon within declared spatial predictor transport domain
Each source-specific fitted model has nonconstant predicted relative suitability across independent admitted sites; otherwise source-specific tau-b unestimable
If fewer than five sites for a taxon, descriptive ranks only, no nominal significance claim
If no site-level variation in plot detection fractions, rank test unestimable not a negative or positive ecological conclusion

source_overlap_barrier.if_any_proven_training_row_overlap: do not claim independent validation of that frozen model against NEON without a separately versioned, leakage-clean refit and new heldout panel
source_overlap_barrier.if_zero_key_overlap: still require occurrenceID, dates, coordinates, and republished-dataset crosswalk; no automatic independence claim

forbidden: Read NEON plant species detections before source-lineage acceptance and separate authorization
Choose favorable NEON sites or taxa from observed species labels
Interpret missing or absent plot rows as biological zero
Use original Level-A source-discordance q95 as NEON predictive-accuracy threshold
Use all 400m2 plot-bouts as independent macroclimate replicates
Treat site-centroid proximity to sample comparison background points as formal species area accessibility
Interpret non-significant site-level correlation as evidence that a biological interaction is absent
